enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Roll to left side. Sleep. Roll to right side. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Kick off blanket. Sleep. Pull blanket back. Sleep. Turn to back. Sleep.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Enter bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on faucet. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands under water. Turn off faucet. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Turn on faucet. Rinse toothbrush. Turn off faucet. Wipe mouth with towel. Hang towel. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, making toast and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Open toaster. Insert bread slices. Press toaster lever. Pick up kettle. Fill kettle with water from sink. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Pick up knife. Spread butter on toast. Kettle boils. Pour hot water into cup. Add tea bag. Pick up toast. Bite toast. Chew. Swallow. Drink tea. Finish breakfast. Rinse cup. Place cup in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking phone messages about the transport strike
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Scroll down. Type reply message. Send message. Lock phone. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading news online and planning the remote workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through articles. Tap on article. Read article. Scroll down. Tap back. Open calendar app. Check schedule. Add event. Set reminder. Lock phone. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on the computer, answering emails and coordinating community program logistics
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in with password. Open email client. Read new emails. Open email. Type reply. Send reply. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Open spreadsheet. Update data. Save spreadsheet. Pick up phone. Make call. Speak on phone. Hang up. Put down phone. Continue typing.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Cut ingredients. Prepare sandwich. Open microwave. Place plate inside. Close microwave. Press start. Microwave beeps. Open microwave. Take out plate. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Finish lunch. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Afternoon work on the computer, drafting program reports and joining video calls with community partners
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open report document. Type report. Save report. Open video conferencing app. Join meeting. Adjust camera. Speak. Mute microphone. Unmute microphone. Share screen. Stop sharing. Leave meeting. Close app. Continue typing report. Save report.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding after work and resting on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Lie down on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Put down remote. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Place pan in sink.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Repeat eating. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink. Wipe mouth with napkin.
Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Put down remote.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Pick up plates from table. Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Pick up glasses. Carry to dishwasher. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load glasses. Load utensils. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Pick up sponge. Wipe table. Rinse sponge. Place sponge in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and completing nightly hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and planning the next day's schedule on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie down on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Check schedule. Add event. Set reminder. Lock phone. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Roll to side. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to other side. Sleep.
